title: critoniopsis quinqueflora
intro: Critoniopsis quinqueflora, commonly known as the Five-Flowered Critoniopsis, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Critoniopsis quinqueflora include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
